title: Sentinel errors and wrapping
hints: A sentinel error is a package-level value, such as ErrNotFound, that callers compare against. Adding context with fmt.Errorf must keep the original error reachable.
The %w verb wraps an error: errors.Is can then find ErrNotFound inside the new error. %v only copies the message text, which loses the connection.
if !ok { return 0, fmt.Errorf("lookup %q: %w", key, ErrNotFound) }; and in Price, check if v < 0 { return 0, fmt.Errorf("price of %q: %w", key, ErrInvalid) }.
